world.title: 'Owned and controlled by US govt': Musk refutes Ukraine's charge of crippling Starlink
world.summary: Elon Musk denied Ukraine's claim that SpaceX restricted access to its Starlink satellite internet, which allegedly impacted military drone operations. Musk stated that any limitations on the service were imposed by the US government, not by SpaceX. His comments come amid ongoing tensions regarding the use of satellite communications in the conflict between Ukraine and Russia.

world.title: US considers easing sanctions on shadow fleet vessels to cut freight rates, official says
world.summary: The Trump administration is contemplating easing sanctions on shadow fleet vessels that transport oil and petroleum products from countries like Russia, Iran, and Venezuela. This potential move aims to address the record-high global freight rates, according to a US official. The decision reflects ongoing efforts to manage economic pressures related to energy transportation and international trade.

world.title: Yemen's Houthis seek to build missiles with Chinese parts amid rising tensions with Saudi, Israel: Report
world.summary: Yemen's Houthi rebels are reportedly pursuing Chinese-made components to enhance their ballistic missile capabilities. This development raises concerns regarding regional security, particularly in relation to potential strikes on Saudi Arabia and Israel. The report from Conflict Armament Research highlights the Houthis' increasing access to advanced weaponry, which could escalate tensions in an already volatile region.

business.title: Stock Market Today: All You Need To Know Before Going Into Trade On October 15
business.summary: On October 15, the Indian stock market's benchmark equity indices closed lower on Wednesday. Key stocks are in the news, alongside significant brokerage calls and complete trade setups. Trends on GIFT Nifty indicate potential movements for traders. Investors are advised to stay informed about market conditions and brokerage recommendations before making trading decisions today.

business.title: Stocks in news: Reliance Industries, Jio Financial, Tata Tech, HDB Financial and Wipro
business.summary: Indian equity benchmarks closed lower after a volatile session, influenced by strong wholesale inflation and high crude oil prices. The Nifty 50 fell, testing the support zone of 22,580-22,620, which may weaken with repeated tests. Companies like Reliance Industries and Tata Technologies are expected to attract attention due to their upcoming quarterly earnings reports.

business.title: Ambani’s mega-IPO faces valuation concern
business.summary: Jio Platforms, led by Indian tycoon Mukesh Ambani, is set to launch an IPO later this month. However, the offering faces concerns regarding its valuation, as investors assess the company's financial health and future prospects. The IPO is part of Ambani's broader strategy to expand his telecommunications and digital services empire amid increasing competition in the market.

technology.title: Mick Gordon On How He Helped to Make Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2’s Climactic Boss Fight “Big and Bombastic”
technology.summary: Mick Gordon, renowned Australian composer, discusses his role in creating the climactic boss fight for Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2. He emphasizes his desire to make the experience "big and bombastic," reflecting his passion for delivering powerful soundscapes. Gordon's approach aims to enhance the game's intensity, ensuring it resonates with players and elevates the overall gaming experience.

technology.title: Xbox Nano Controller price and release date: Features, connectivity and everything to know about Microsoft’s new gamepad
technology.summary: The Xbox Nano Controller will launch in November, aiming for the holiday shopping season. It features Xbox Wireless and Bluetooth connectivity, allowing compatibility with Xbox consoles, Windows PCs, and mobile devices. Designed for accessibility, the compact gamepad targets children and players with smaller hands, enhancing the gaming experience for a broader audience. Pricing details have yet to be announced.

technology.title: GTA 6 updates: CyberLeek reportedly leaks the game's ending ahead of launch
technology.summary: Cyberleek has leaked new information about GTA 6, which is scheduled for release on November 19, 2026. The anonymous leaker shared a clip on October 14 that allegedly includes snippets of the game's ending. This development adds to the ongoing Cyberleek saga, raising anticipation and concern among fans regarding potential spoilers before the official launch.

sports.title: Five wickets in an over: South African bowler makes history with rare feat - Watch
sports.summary: Chad Laycock, a 19-year-old bowler, made history on Tuesday by becoming the first player to take five wickets in a single over in South African T20 cricket. He achieved this remarkable feat while representing KZN Inland against the Titans during the CSA Pro20 Cup. Laycock's performance marks a significant milestone in South African cricket history.

sports.title: OMA vs CAN Today Match Prediction and Betting Tips, Odds and Live Score
sports.summary: Oman (OMA) will face Canada (CAN) in the 137th match of the ICC Cricket World Cup League Two on October 15, 2026, at 11:30 IST. The match will take place at Al Amerat Cricket Ground (Ministry Turf 1) in Al Amerat. Predictions and betting tips are available for this ODI encounter as teams compete for crucial points.

sports.title: Mourinho: “The cat is out of the bag with the federation”
sports.summary: José Mourinho expressed frustration following Real Madrid's 4-3 victory over AS Roma in the Champions League. During a press conference, he questioned the appropriateness of a player learning about team decisions through media rather than directly from the federation. His comments highlighted concerns regarding communication within the organization, indicating a broader issue he believes needs addressing.

health.title: India’s ageing crisis demands urgent action, warns Himachal doctor
health.summary: India is experiencing a significant ageing crisis, with a rapidly growing elderly population. Despite two decades of focusing on its youth, the country’s healthcare, social security, housing, transport, and family support systems are inadequately prepared to meet the needs of this demographic shift. Urgent action is required to address the challenges posed by an ageing society, warns a Himachal doctor.

health.title: New UPF study strengthens case for statutory controls on junk food advertising
health.summary: A study published in Nature Metabolism reveals that ultra-processed foods (UPFs) elicit unique metabolic and neural responses compared to minimally processed foods, despite similar nutritional content. This research supports the argument for statutory regulations on junk food advertising, highlighting potential health risks associated with UPFs. The findings may influence future public health policies regarding food marketing and consumption.

health.title: These common infections are linked to 12% of new cancer cases, study says
health.summary: A recent study published in The Lancet reveals that infections linked to certain cancers account for 12% of new cancer cases globally. These infections are often treatable or preventable, indicating that many cancer cases could potentially be avoided. The findings highlight the importance of addressing infectious diseases to reduce cancer incidence worldwide.

science.title: Why large dogs age faster than smaller breeds: DNA study
science.summary: A recent study reveals that large dog breeds age faster than smaller ones due to specific DNA changes. This research highlights the connection between a dog's size and its lifespan, with larger breeds like Great Danes generally having shorter lifespans compared to smaller breeds such as Chihuahuas. The findings may provide insights into healthier ageing in dogs.

science.title: A trip to Mars could come at a heartbreaking cost
science.summary: Astronauts traveling to Mars will face significant challenges from radiation and weightlessness, which Earth’s atmosphere currently protects them from. These factors are known to adversely affect the human body, but the full extent of their impact and the duration of these effects remain uncertain. Understanding these risks is crucial for future deep space missions and astronaut health.

science.title: A detector buried nearly a mile underground records an unexplained particle interaction in the hunt for dark matter
science.summary: Scientists involved in the LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ) dark matter experiment have recorded a single particle interaction that remains unexplained by known background processes. This detection occurred nearly a mile underground, where the LZ detector aims to uncover dark matter's nature. Researchers continue to analyze the findings, seeking to understand the implications for existing theories in particle physics.
